name: What storage upgrades are actually worth it in a small kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What storage upgrades are actually worth it in a small kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A compact kitchen should prioritize storage that is easy to reach, not just maximum cabinet count. Deep drawers near the cooking zone, a pull-out pantry, tray dividers, an organized waste center, and corner solutions can outperform awkward shelves. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate storage priorities into the layout and cabinet selection rather than adding accessories after installation. Key factors include cooking frequency, cookware size, small appliances, recycling needs, and whether children or mobility limitations affect reach. Inventory what you actually own before choosing cabinet interiors. Reserve prime locations for items used daily and avoid paying for accessories that duplicate existing storage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize accessible storage: deep drawers, a pull-out pantry, tray dividers, organized waste storage, and practical corner solutions. Choose based on your cookware, small appliances, recycling habits, and reach needs rather than filling every cabinet with costly accessories.
